meta.title: The Survival of Sarah Rose — Russian localization + AI voice pack
meta.description: The Survival of Sarah Rose русификатор: полный перевод 68 254 строк + AI-озвучка 75+ клонированных голосов на русском и английском. Бесплатно, 18+.

hero.title: The Survival of Sarah Rose — Russian localization + AI voice pack
hero.subtitle: Unofficial fan translation into Russian plus a fully voiced game: 75+ cloned voices with emotion-aware delivery for every line.
hero.badgeFormat: Opus 24 kbps — pack is only ~1.6 GB
hero.ctaSteam: The Survival of Sarah Rose on Steam
hero.installHint: Requires a purchased copy of the game on Steam. Free, CC BY-NC 4.0.

features.title: What you get
features.translateText: 68 254 lines: dialogue, narration, UI, character names — all 19 arcs of the game.
features.voiceText: Cloned voices for every character via CosyVoice3 — the game becomes fully voiced in Russian and English.
features.emotionText: Every line carries the narrator's state: anger, desire, whisper, sarcasm — not a monotone reading.
features.voicesText: Sarah, Narrator, King Orwell, Kate, Thomas, Varga and dozens of other characters.

voice.title: Voice acting progress
voice.total: 94.2% voiced overall (126 677 of 134 534 lines, data as of 2026-10-15). Generation runs in the background — a few days to 100%.
voice.ru: Russian (RU): 92.4% — 14 arcs fully done, Training in progress
voice.en: English (EN): 96.0% — 16 arcs fully done, HyralArc in progress
voice.missing: If a line has no voice file yet — the game just plays it silently (no errors, no crashes).

install.title: Installation
install.step1: Download the ZIP and unpack its contents into the game folder (Steam: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\The Survival of Sarah Rose), replacing files
install.step2: Launch the game and choose Language → Russian in the settings (or English — the voice pack follows the language)
install.step3: Done. The first launch may be slightly slower — Ren'Py rebuilds its cache
install.note: Requires the game bought on Steam. The project is unofficial and not affiliated with the developers or publishers.
